name: HomePanel MR
summary:
Your smart home, right in front of you.

HomePanel MR brings your Home Assistant devices into mixed reality on Meta Quest 3 and Quest 3S. Place a small marker near a real device, look toward it to reveal controls, and select an action with your hands. Look away and the controls fade out.

• Switch lights and individual switch channels.
• Adjust supported light brightness, fan speed and thermostat temperature.
• Open, close or stop supported covers.
• Browse rooms and everyday devices, with an All devices vi
